name: Maître des cordages
description: Tall wiry adult, copper skin with black stripes, angular high brow, four exposed mandibles, long thin dreadlocks threaded through a plain leather tie. Short tan shoulder cape, sleeveless canvas vest, dark fitted trousers and bronze shin plates. Holds a compact thick coil of caravan securing rope and a bronze tensioning ratchet; narrow tool roll attached at hip. One foot slightly ahead.
